confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors rest on search results: Fujikawaguchiko town-level restaurant budget medians and the town's official gourmet guide prices (some sources are several years old), plus Japan-wide 2026 price-tracker and drink-guide figures. Yen-denominated prices were converted at roughly 156 yen per USD, a late-October 2026 rate seen in search; the July 2026 rate was not verified. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker, drawn from scattered Tokyo and general guide figures and cross-checked against the beer anchor. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not based on live booking pages or listings, and are the least certain. The FX figure is the latest RBA observation found in search (18 Nov 2026); no 19 Nov figure was located.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors start from Fujikawaguchiko town-level restaurant budget data where found, cross-checked against Japan-wide 2026 price figures and Tokyo bar guide prices for drinks, adjusted for a smaller resort town. Accommodation is a general-knowledge benchmark for Japanese resort-town rates in July, which is peak Mt. Fuji season.
